capabilities: Two-way sync TaskNotes tasks with CalDAV VTODO lists on multiple accounts
Route tasks to lists by tags and project membership
Map statuses, priorities, recurrence, reminders and dependencies to VTODO fields
Preview the first sync per list before anything is written
Filter tasks out of sync by tags and folders
extras: Not in the community plugin directory; install via BRAT or manually from GitHub releases. Tested only on desktop; mobile is untried. Passwords are stored in Obsidian's secret storage, requiring Obsidian 1.11.4+.
intentEvidence: Built on TaskNotes by Callum Alpass and its runtime API.
motivation: The sync began as a pull request to TaskNotes (#2280); moving it into a companion plugin using TaskNotes' runtime API lets it work with stock TaskNotes without waiting for a merge.
problem: Tasks stored as TaskNotes notes stay inside the vault and don't appear in external calendar or task apps, and server-side edits don't reach the notes.

relations.evidence: Built on TaskNotes by Callum Alpass and its runtime API.

requires.name: CalDAV server (Nextcloud, iCloud, Radicale, Baikal, etc.)

summary: Two-way sync of TaskNotes tasks with CalDAV task lists (VTODO) such as Nextcloud Tasks, Apple Reminders, Radicale or Baikal.
